title: Lanterns of Kindness
exactArtworkPrompt: Create an immersive dimensional paper sculpture of a welcoming community workshop at blue hour. A glowing amber paper lantern is the clear focal subject on a long walnut table, surrounded by carefully folded care packages, colorful fabric scraps, simple heart-shaped paper tags without writing, and small jars of autumn flowers. Layer an open doorway, softly lit shelves, warm window squares and navy evening sky behind the table for depth. Use rich indigo, burnt orange, warm cream and touches of sage, tactile deckled paper edges, sculpted folds, soft shadows and cinematic lamplight. Make the scene abundant, hopeful and neighborly with a naturally readable title pocket above the lantern. Expressive warm cream cut-paper lettering should suit this handmade scene. No logos, real organizations or extra printed words.
